cases.seed_sql:
INSERT INTO webhook_endpoint (public_id, user_id, screen_id, url, events, consecutive_failures) VALUES
 ('opsal0000001', 1, 1, 'https://hooks.example.com/baskfy', '["screen.entries"]', 0),
 ('opsal0000002', 1, 1, 'http://localhost:9000/hook', '["screen.entries"]', 2),
 ('opsal0000003', 1, 1, 'http://10.0.0.5/hook', '["screen.exits"]', 0),
 ('opsal0000004', 1, 1, 'https://inactive.example.com/x', '["screen.entries"]', 0);
UPDATE webhook_endpoint SET is_active = false WHERE public_id = 'opsal0000004';
INSERT INTO webhook_delivery (endpoint_id, event, idempotency_key, payload, status, attempts, next_attempt_at)
SELECT e.id, v.event, v.key, v.payload::jsonb, v.status, v.attempts, v.next_at::timestamptz
FROM (VALUES
 ('opsal0000001', 'screen.entries', 'k1', '{"b": 1, "a": [1, 2.5]}', 'pending', 0, '2026-10-30 09:00:00+00'),
 ('opsal0000001', 'screen.entries', 'k2', '{"x": "y"}', 'pending', 2, '2026-10-30 09:10:00+00'),
 ('opsal0000002', 'screen.entries', 'k3', '{}', 'pending', 0, '2026-10-30 09:05:00+00'),
 ('opsal0000003', 'screen.exits', 'k4', '{"n": null}', 'pending', 1, '2026-10-30 09:20:00+00'),
 ('opsal0000004', 'screen.entries', 'k5', '{}', 'pending', 0, '2026-10-30 09:00:00+00'),
 ('opsal0000001', 'screen.entries', 'k6', '{}', 'pending', 0, '2026-10-30 23:00:00+00'),
 ('opsal0000001', 'screen.entries', 'k7', '{}', 'delivered', 1, NULL)
) AS v(pub, event, key, payload, status, attempts, next_at)
JOIN webhook_endpoint e ON e.public_id = v.pub;
cases.note: four due deliveries on three active endpoints: a public name (does not resolve under the guard), localhost, a private literal; inactive, not-yet-due and delivered rows untouched
